subject: Flash Engage: 3-touch mini-series for engineers — copy + links
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Flash Engage: 3-touch mini-series for engineers — copy + links

Team,

Summary: I sketched a compact, low-friction 3-email mini-series aimed at engineers and infra/infra-adjacent PMs at mid-market AI-first startups. Goal is to drive 20–30 min lab signups (hands-on, self-serve). This is a short-burst cadence: Day 0 (announce / quick value), Day 3 (technical deep-dive snippet + invite), Day 7 (last-call + one-pager).

Targets: small list seed (existing event attendees, product trial users, and webinar opt-ins). I want to push a high-CTA, low-friction link to a 1-click lab slot (no long forms). We'll use federated tracking: unique token per link + fallback UTM parameters.

Assets attached: flash-mini-series-copy_v1.docx (copy + subject variants), track-links-sheet.csv (per-segment link tokens), one-pager-acmeai.pdf (customer-specific one-pager).

Key asks:
- Ben: can you generate the HubSpot audience (engineer personas only) from the trial-engagers cohort and drop the list ID? I want exclusion for anyone who has a lab in the last 60 days.
- Marissa: subject test suggestions — keep to two variants per send; short vs technical.
- Olga: can you confirm the 1-click slot URL supports prepopulated company and email fields for Acme-specific tokens? If not, we fallback to the generic flow.

Tracking plan (high level):
- Link skeleton: go.redwood.ai/flash?tok=XXXXX -> resolves to /lab-signup?prefill=...
- We'll append utm_source=email&utm_campaign=flash_engage_v1&utm_medium=mini_series and a hubspot contact token.
- Sheet contains token mapping (see track-links-sheet.csv).

Timing: aim to seed sends the week of Aug 24th. Need list ID and link tokens by Aug 16.

Thanks — sending the copy doc attached for review.

Best,
Mateo
Head of Field Events
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Flash Engage: 3-touch mini-series for engineers — copy + links

Mateo —

Thanks for the plan. Quick notes inline: 

> Targets: small list seed (existing event attendees, product trial users, and webinar opt-ins).
- Can we prioritize trial users with inference-heavy usage (token>2M/month) — higher conversion historically.

> Key asks: Ben: can you generate the HubSpot audience (engineer personas only) from the trial-engagers cohort and drop the list ID?
- Will do. I’ll pull cohort > filter on job_title:(Engineer OR SRE OR Infrastructure) AND last_activity < 60 days. Expect list id HSP-41287 by EOD Aug 12.

Subject test: short variant vs technical variant looks good. I’d add a mobile-first subject (<=38 chars) as variant C for Day 0. Also recommend using first-name personalization token only for trial users — cold folks get generic.

Link tokens: I’ll sync with Apps infra to create token mapping. Two questions:
1) Do we want per-recipient tokens or per-segment? Per-recipient gives better attribution but higher churn on token management.
2) For AcmeAI we should create persistent token so their account team can track clicks in parallel.

I’ll push the HubSpot list and a draft send schedule into the shared drive link (added to related_links).

—Ben
Director, Lifecycle Marketing
Redwood Inference
